newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom plans second ADS tranche early 98-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom plans second ADS tranche early 98-Interfax.

text.p: Russian natural gas group Gazprom plans to place its second issue of American Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange in early 1998, Interfax news agency quoted the company's securities chief as saying on Monday.

Gazprom securities manager Eduard Ivanov was quoted as saying the size of the issue had not yet been decided. Interfax gave no details and Gazprom officials were not immediately available for comment.
Gazprom has issued ADSs to cover about one percent of its stock and foreigners own a total of about two percent.
The ADS, which covers 10 underlying shares, was priced at $15.75 at issue last October. It closed at $18.10 on Friday in London.
The ADS is the only way for foreigners to invest in Gazprom since a recent presidential decree banned foreign purchase of locally traded shares.
The traditionally secretive company is making some efforts at transparency to woo new outside investors. Foreign investment in Gazprom is capped at nine percent of equity.
